answer: Prism review splits one application into three checks: funding uniqueness, a fresh liveness sample, and one work artefact. Three randomly drawn bonded verifiers each issue an ember shard for passing its own check. The applicant forges the identity by combining the three shards within 48 hours, and the chain verifies signatures and window. Filing costs $60 plus $40 per verifier ($180 per identity); each verifier stakes $200, slashed on a proven false approval. Forging 1,000 identities costs $180,000 plus 3,000 fresh evidence sets, with no bulk discount; an honest applicant pays $180 once.
